## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 30 mai 2026 - 30 mai 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs signalent des problèmes de fiabilité. Cela pointe des gaps de qualité qu'un concurrent peut exploiter.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _quietvest_, 30 mai 2026, 5/5: "I have been using this app for years. It is useful, elegant, and flawless. It lets me adapt it for exactly the types of habits I am trying to maintain (or break!) and doesn’t come loaded down with a bunch of unnecessary junk. It has never glitched or had bugs. Would recommend it to anyone trying to form a daily habit or track how well they’re maintaining one. As an additional bonus, it provides graphs of how you’re doing over various periods of time that you can explore when you want. Again, a perfect app."
